title: Machine learning-based prediction of clinical outcomes and left ventricular ejection fraction improvement after percutaneous coronary intervention in patients with reduced ejection fraction.
summary: Retrospective test-set risk stratification and moderate prediction of LVEF improvement. Methods: CatBoost used 53 routine pre/intra-procedural features for one-year outcomes and LVEF improvement after PCI in patients with baseline LVEF<45%. Single-centre held-out retrospective evaluation; no causal estimate of PCI benefit. CatBoost models stratified one-year clinical events and LVEF improvement after PCI among patients with reduced baseline ejection fraction; this is retrospective prognosis, not causal treatment evidence.
